description: Replace the single fixed model pin per role with a declared candidate pool, a cause-classified availability inventory, an entitlement-based cost model, and a phase-level assignment resolved at preflight so an unsatisfiable phase fails before the first role dispatches.

sprint.goal: Make failover safe: candidates are declared in advance, the selection is recorded, constraints are checked against the model that ran, and a retired pin raises a configuration alarm instead of being quietly replaced.

stories.title: Role requirements and ordered candidate pools
